agent.description: TUSA.game AI assistant — multiplayer party platform (Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Clerk, Neon Postgres, SSE)
instructions: Read AGENTS.md before making any changes — it is the orchestration hub with all project context.
Run `npm run build` and `npm test` before committing any changes.
Run `npm run rag:build` after any code change to keep the RAG index fresh.
Use RAG search (`npm run rag:search "query"`) to find relevant code before editing.
Prefer editing existing files over creating new ones unless explicitly required.
Follow the Files to Touch table in AGENTS.md to find the right file for each task.
Never add comments unless asked — match existing code style (no comments).
Never commit unless explicitly asked by the user.

add-game.description: Add a new multiplayer game to the platform

fix-game-bug.description: Debug and fix a game component or engine issue

rag-index.description: Rebuild or search the RAG index
